promises.quote: Action should therefore be taken to prevent future deaths and I believe that you have the power to take such action.
promises.summary: Require response within 56 days to outline actions and timetable

promises.quote: Local policies are now in place at HMP Pentonville and HMP Thameside to ensure that information is shared appropriately and that there is effective communication between prison staff and the healthcare provider.
promises.summary: Implement local policies for information sharing and multi-agency communication

concerns.quote: Failures in relation to information sharing, multi agency communication procedures and inadequate training for staff at the prison services have contributed to this accident.
inadequate training for staff at the prison services

The first reception nurse who saw Mr Williams when he entered HMP Pentonville gave evidence that he had no thoughts of self harm or suicide, but she recorded that he had. It appears she may benefit from additional training and/or supervision. . There was no second reception screen conducted. If Mr Williams was not brought to healthcare staff for his second reception screen then healthcare staff needed to follow this up. . The first reception nurse did not make the referral to the mental health team
concerns.hazard: lack of proper reception screening and mental health referral

concerns.quote: Mr Williams said to several members of staff that he would self harm or hang himself if he wanted something done and it was not happening quickly enough (rather than because he actually wanted to die.) This was recorded on his assessment, care in custody, teamwork (ACCT) document. Some prison officers did not seem familiar with the very important contents of the ACCT, not even the inside cover. concerns.hazard: inadequate understanding of ACCT protocol and risk documentation

concerns.quote: The prison officers did not have even the most basic first aid and cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) training. | am aware from other inquests that this is not provided at a national level. | have written about this before. It seems a significant gap, even allowing for the fact that there are always two trained nurses on site.
